questions.title: How far can an appellate court review a Board’s decision over an Immigration Judge’s denial under §1252(b)(4)(A)?
questions.question_body: I’m trying to understand why Jimenez v Bondi says appellate courts reviewing a Board’s order apply a *substantial‑evidence* standard, yet also state they look only at *the administrative record upon which the order of removal is based*. Does this mean courts cannot reconsider any factual determinations actually made by the Board, even if those facts were contested during lower‑court proceedings?

questions.title: "Threats" Alone Are Insufficient – What Threshold Does Past Persecution Require?
questions.question_body: "Kirks v Holder" says mere verbal intimidation isn’t enough for past persecution unless there has been inflicted harm or psychological trauma severe enough to qualify (“more than merely threatening”). In Jimenez v Bondi many phone calls threatened Jiménez so frequently that he feared harming himself or his family, yet those calls were ruled insufficientally violent. How does marshaling past violence versus ongoing terror shape admissibility standards?

questions.title: "Central Reason" Test – How Do Courts Decide Whether Political Opinion Was Motive?
questions.question_body: "Rivera‑Barrientos" explains that perceived politics must be “at least one central reason” in persecutors’ conduct, not merely incidental or subordinate. Jiménez argues Don Rafael attacked him because he worked against Petro while defenders say his attack stemmed mainly from robberies tied burglary at him rented property. How do judges weigh partial motives against overall intent?

questions.title: "Unable/Unwilling" Finds – What Evidence Proves Colombian Officials Won’t Protect?
questions.question_body: "Aviles‑Gonzalez" notes prosecution cautions against relying solely upon interrogation reports implying police apathy apportional weakness should reflect systemic failures rather than isolated incidents "belonging police officers." In our case Raymond interviewed several officers who told him nothing would happen even while repeat attempts had been carried out against Don Rafael’s operations. Isolated discouragement statements fail either way?
